OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth client registrations, grants, and tokens. Create a new namespace for this deployment. It does not store calendar events.

ICLOUD_USERNAME.description: Full email address used for the Apple Account and iCloud Calendar.

ICLOUD_APP_PASSWORD.description: App-specific password created at https://account.apple.com/. See https://support.apple.com/102654.

APPROVAL_PASSWORD.description: A separate password that protects new MCP client approvals. This field is required for the default setup. Do not reuse an Apple password.

CALENDAR_TIME_ZONE.description: Default IANA time zone for calendars without one, such as `America/New_York`. Cloudflare cannot detect it automatically.
